title: Creating a Request for Limit Items
body:
Creating a Request for Limit Items

You can add enhanced limit items (category E) to requests and send these requests to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

Context

In the Guided Buying Capability with SAP Ariba Buying (2NV) integration scenario, buyers can add limit items in guided buying requests for goods and lean services that correspond to the item category E in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. Limit items are procured without following the goods receipt and the service sheet processes. The requests for limit items are characterized by validity periods to define the effective dates of the procurement process and predefined amount limits to control item prices.

Procedure

  1. Search the catalog for the limit item.
    Tip

    Limit items display the This is a limit item checkbox. To procure a limit item as a non-limit item, deselect the checkbox. If the checkbox isn't available, the item doesn't qualify as a limit item.

  2. Check the This is a limit item checkbox and enter the following information:

    • Start date

    • End date

    • Expected value

    • Overall limit

    Click Add to add the item to your cart.

  3. If you can't find the catalog limit item, create a non-catalog request for a limit item:
    1. From the home page, choose Quick Links  Request a non-catalog item.
    2. Choose the Goods or Services tab.
    3. In the Product name or Service name field, enter a name for the product or service you need.
    4. In the Category field, choose a category that describes what you're requesting. If the category is mapped to a commodity code applicable to limit items, enter the Start date, End date, Expected value, and Overall limit values.
    5. Optional: Add a supplier.
    6. Click Add to cart.
  4. After you've finished adding items to your request, click Check out.
  5. Review the details on the checkout page, and then click Submit.
    Note

    Users in time zones outside of GMT may not be able to submit requisitions with service line items to SAP S/4HANA when the service start date is the current date. To ensure that users can submit requisitions with the current date as the service start date, enable the Allow current date as start date for service items (Application.Purchasing.S4Hana.AllowCurrentDateAsStartDateForServiceItems) parameter. For more information, see Allow current date as start date for service items.

    A confirmation dialog box displays. Click Done to return to the home page.

Results

Guided buying sends the data on the request to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition. A purchase requisition is created in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
